description: Rename one station. Takes the station id from get_stations. Renaming is safe and takes effect everywhere — past orders, sessions and reports store the id and look the name up. The name is the ONLY thing the cabinet lets anyone change on an existing station, and the only thing this tool changes. A station cannot be moved to another outlet, and its device, card reader and POS layout are not editable from here — moving a till to another store means creating a new station there and deleting this one, which loses its id.

stationId.description: Station id from get_stations — not a name
